headline: I turn overlooked
people into hires
hero.support: At 23 I sent one cold message and ended up with a $100k+ chief of staff role and equity. Now I teach people the method that got me there.

company.name: RallyUp
company.body: I'm chief of staff and an investor at RallyUp. We build LinkedIn audiences for B2B founders and executives: every post hand-written in their voice, engineered to reach the people who buy from them. In 2026 we've shipped 700+ posts for leadership teams at PandaDoc, Letter.ai, Anchor Browser and Andel.

newsletter.name: The Draft
newsletter.label: Free weekly email
newsletter.pitch: One letter a week on what actually moved: the post that worked, the message that got answered, the thing I got wrong. You get it while it is still fresh, not once it has been tidied into a framework.
newsletter.proof: Last year that thinking took my own LinkedIn to 146,676 impressions, up 1,506% on the prior 365 days.
newsletter.reassurance: One email a week. Leave whenever you like, no hard feelings.
